description: Sim 90 — CMSTG joint CMB+BAO parameter fit. Finds (H0, Omega_m, Lambda0) minimising chi2_CMB + chi2_BAO simultaneously for CMSTG (Lambda0 free) and LCDM (Lambda0=0). CMB likelihood: Gaussian approximation built from Planck 2018 TT+TE+EE+lowE published parameter covariance (Table 2 + correlation structure from Planck 2018 VI, arXiv:1807.06209). BAO likelihood: exact full-covariance chi2 reusing SIM87 data and covariance. This resolves the Phase 5b finding: the CMSTG BAO-only best-fit (H0=68.14, Omega_m=0.294) was in 30.1-sigma CMB tension. The joint fit finds the CMB+BAO consistent CMSTG cosmology.

planck_cmb_constraints.note: Planck 2018 TT+TE+EE+lowE best-fit and 1-sigma errors (Table 2, Aghanim+2020 arXiv:1807.06209). Correlation rho(H0, Omega_m) = -0.90 from the acoustic-scale degeneracy (D_A(z*) direction). This builds a 2x2 CMB parameter covariance matrix C_CMB. chi2_CMB = (x-mu)^T C_CMB^{-1} (x-mu) where x=(H0, Omega_m). This is the Gaussian approximation to the full Planck likelihood, valid near the best-fit.

bao_data.note: BAO data and full covariance matrix from SIM87 (BOSS DR12 + eBOSS DR16 + Ly-alpha). 12 data points (DM/rd, DH/rd at 5 redshifts), full 12x12 covariance from published rho(DM,DH). See SIM87 for full provenance.

sound_horizon.note: Planck 2018 sound horizon at drag epoch (Mpc). Used as fiducial for BAO rescaling. rd enters BAO chi2 as a free parameter (fit jointly with H0, Omega_m).

optimization.note: Optimize chi2_total = chi2_CMB(H0, Omega_m) + chi2_BAO(H0, Omega_m, rd, Lambda0). For LCDM: Lambda0 fixed to 0. For CMSTG: Lambda0 is free. rd is free in both (BAO alone cannot constrain H0 and rd separately). Note: CMB provides an independent H0 constraint through D_A(z*), partially breaking the H0-rd BAO degeneracy in the joint fit.

grid_scan.note: Coarse grid scan to visualise chi2_CMB+BAO landscape before Nelder-Mead refinement.

acceptance.note: CMSTG acceptable if chi2_CMSTG_joint - chi2_LCDM_joint < 9 (3-sigma, 2 extra dof). Δchi2 < 4 would imply 2-sigma, acceptable for publication.

context.question: Can CMSTG find a (H0, Omega_m, Lambda0) that fits both CMB and BAO simultaneously, with Δchi2(CMSTG-LCDM) < 9?
